title: Enabling Novel Mission Operations and Interactions with ROSA: The Robot Operating System Agent
summary: Describes ROSA, an LLM agent that lets operators inspect and command ROS systems in natural language through a curated tool set, and discusses safety and operational considerations.
key_takeaways: Tool-based LLM access keeps robot actions auditable
Targets operators, not only developers

title: OpenFly: A Comprehensive Platform for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Presents a multi-engine aerial VLN platform with automated data generation, a large outdoor benchmark and a keyframe-aware VLN model.
key_takeaways: Automated toolchain scales aerial VLN data
Multiple rendering engines reduce sim bias

title: AerialVLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation for UAVs
summary: ICCV 2023 paper introducing a city-scale UAV vision-and-language navigation task, simulator and baselines.
key_takeaways: Aerial VLN is much harder than indoor VLN
Long trajectories and 3D actions

title: CityNav: A Large-Scale Dataset for Real-World Aerial Navigation
summary: Introduces a language-goal aerial navigation dataset built on real-city 3D data with geographic metadata, and baselines using map-based grounding.
key_takeaways: Geographic map priors improve aerial language navigation
Human demonstrations from a web simulator

title: ViNT: A Foundation Model for Visual Navigation
summary: Trains a transformer navigation policy across many robot datasets and shows it adapts to new robots and tasks with little data.
key_takeaways: Cross-embodiment pretraining works for navigation
Image-goal policy plus topological graph

title: NoMaD: Goal Masked Diffusion Policies for Navigation and Exploration
summary: Single diffusion policy that handles both goal-directed navigation and undirected exploration by masking the goal.
key_takeaways: One model for explore and goal-reach
Runs on small robots

title: Visual Language Maps for Robot Navigation
summary: Fuses visual-language features into 3D maps so robots can localize landmarks named in open-vocabulary language and navigate to them.
key_takeaways: Language-indexed spatial maps
Enables spatial instructions like 'between X and Y'

title: LM-Nav: Robotic Navigation with Large Pre-Trained Models of Language, Vision, and Action
summary: Combines an LLM for landmark extraction, CLIP for grounding and a visual navigation model to follow long route instructions outdoors.
key_takeaways: No language-annotated robot data needed
Modular pretrained composition

title: TypeFly: Flying Drones with Large Language Model
summary: Proposes a compact drone programming language for LLM output, cutting token count and latency while keeping plans checkable.
key_takeaways: Constrain LLM output to a small DSL
Latency matters for flight

title: ChatGPT for Robotics: Design Principles and Model Abilities
summary: Early study of prompting strategies and API design for using ChatGPT to generate robot and drone control code, with AirSim demos.
key_takeaways: Expose a high-level function library to the LLM
Keep a human in the loop to review code

title: ConceptGraphs: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs for Perception and Planning
summary: Builds object-centric 3D scene graphs with open-vocabulary labels from RGB-D and uses an LLM to plan over them.
key_takeaways: Compact object-level maps for LLM planning
Uses 2D foundation models

title: NaVid: Video-based VLM Plans the Next Step for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Video-based VLM that plans navigation actions from monocular RGB history without maps, odometry or depth.
key_takeaways: Map-free language navigation
Sim-to-real transfer

title: Model Context Protocol specification
summary: The specification for MCP, the protocol LLM clients use to call tools and read resources from servers; the basis of the ROS, MAVLink and QGIS MCP servers.
key_takeaways: Tools, resources and prompts as server primitives
Transport and authorization rules

title: OpenShoe: open source embedded foot-mounted INS
summary: Project site for OpenShoe, an open hardware and software ZUPT-aided foot-mounted INS module, described in the PLANS 2012 paper 'Foot-mounted INS for Everybody' and follow-up IPIN 2014 work.
key_takeaways: Open hardware + firmware for ZUPT-aided INS
Module reports per-step displacement and heading change

title: Deep Event Visual Odometry
summary: Learned event-only monocular VO trained on simulated events that generalizes to real event datasets.
key_takeaways: Event-only VO without frames
Simulation-trained, real-world tested

title: cuVSLAM: CUDA accelerated visual odometry and mapping
summary: Describes NVIDIA's GPU-accelerated VO/SLAM supporting from one to many cameras with optional IMU, designed for real-time edge deployment.
key_takeaways: Multi-camera rigs supported
Runs in real time on Jetson

title: R-Mode Baltic and R-Mode Baltic 2
authors: DLR Institute of Communications and Navigation
summary: DLR project page for R-Mode Baltic, which built a Baltic Sea testbed adding ranging signals to existing maritime radio beacons and AIS base stations as a terrestrial backup to GNSS, continued by R-Mode Baltic 2 and ORMOBASS.
key_takeaways: Reuses existing MF beacons and VHF AIS for ranging
Moving toward IALA standardisation

title: eLoran Independent Assessment Team findings (PNT Advisory Board briefing)
summary: Briefing to the US Space-Based PNT Advisory Board summarizing the 2006-2008 independent assessment of eLoran as a GPS backup, its accuracy and its independent failure modes.
key_takeaways: eLoran has different physical failure modes than GNSS
Recommended as backup for timing and harbor navigation

title: NVIDIA Jetson AI Lab
summary: Tutorial hub for running generative AI, VLMs and robotics models on Jetson devices, built around jetson-containers.
key_takeaways: Step-by-step onboard LLM/VLM deployment
Covers ROS and robotics integrations
